A.completion_rule: A must pass and freeze before the corresponding B step may use its results.

B.source_rule: B may use only the latest passed A freeze package plus LATEST_WORD and explicitly approved source materials.

ledgers.B_update_rule: Only rows/items affected by the current B change set may be added or updated; unaffected entries must remain unchanged.

writing_quality.principle_scope: Only theory directly used by this problem is written.
writing_quality.formula_rule: A core formula must participate in solving, an evaluation metric, or an explanation; decorative formulas are prohibited.
writing_quality.evidence_requirement: Any evidential/evaluative claim must be backed by a number, interval, table/figure, or validation evidence reference; otherwise downgrade the wording or revise the blueprint.

state_machine.guard: Before every step, the requested step must equal CURRENT_ALLOWED_STEP and the prior token/next gate must be valid. Otherwise stop without executing.
state_machine.p0_rule: Any unresolved OPEN_P0 blocks passing a dependent step unless an explicit protocol rule marks it non-blocking.

freeze_invalidation.action: Invalidate affected freezes and all dependent Word states; roll back to the earliest affected A step, redo STEP13, then redo every dependent later step.
freeze_invalidation.non_substantive_changes: Formatting-only changes that do not alter data/code/model/key parameters/core results do not invalidate A freezes.
